source_metadata.organization: National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), MHA, Govt. of India
source_metadata.title: Flood Water Rescue (FWR) Technical Equipment Specifications and Safety Guidelines

IRB_Inflatable_Rescue_Boat.material: Heavy-duty Hypalon / Neoprene fabric (1100-1670 dtex) resistant to punctures, UV, and hydrocarbons.
IRB_Inflatable_Rescue_Boat.chambers: Multi-compartment inflatable buoyancy tubes (typically 3 to 5 independent air chambers plus inflatable keel).
IRB_Inflatable_Rescue_Boat.rated_capacity: 6 to 10 persons max (including 2 crew members). Overloading leads to center-of-gravity elevation and rollover.
IRB_Inflatable_Rescue_Boat.working_pressure: 0.20 to 0.25 bar (2.9 to 3.6 psi). Requires pressure gauge monitoring in hot ambient temperatures.

OBM_Outboard_Motor.propeller_guard: MANDATORY stainless steel circular shroud surrounding propeller to prevent blade strikes on victims and debris entrapment.
OBM_Outboard_Motor.fuel_system: 24L portable fuel tank with primer bulb and emergency kill switch tether (dead-man switch).
OBM_Outboard_Motor.cooling: Raw water impeller cooling. Must ensure intake screens are clear of silt and mud.

PFD_Personal_Flotation_Devices.rescuer_pfd: Type V Swiftwater Rescue Vest with minimum 22 lbs (98 N to 150 N) buoyancy, quick-release chest harness, and cowtail tether.
PFD_Personal_Flotation_Devices.survivor_pfd: Type III / Keyhole buoyant life vest with reflective SOLAS tape, whistle, and secure crotch straps for children.

Water_Rescue_Helmets.specification: EN 1385 certified water rescue helmets with drainage vents and closed-cell foam liner (non-water-absorbing).

Life_Buoys_and_Throw_Bags.throw_bags: 20m to 25m floating polypropylene rope (8mm to 10mm, minimum 9 kN breaking strength) in high-visibility cordura bag.
Life_Buoys_and_Throw_Bags.life_buoy: SOLAS approved 30-inch rigid ring buoy with 30m grab line; Remote-controlled motorized lifebuoy for rapid victim reach.

Environmental_Sensors.flow_meter: Hydro-acoustic or mechanical impellor flow meter to measure stream velocity before deploying personnel.
Environmental_Sensors.wind_meter: Handheld anemometer to gauge cross-winds for boat stability and helicopter LZ safety.

Underwater_Comms_and_Lighting.comms: Full-face mask wireless ultrasonic underwater transceivers for dive teams.
Underwater_Comms_and_Lighting.torches: IP68 waterproof LED dive lights (minimum 1000 lumens) and chemical lightsticks (cyalume) for night victim tagging.
